title: strace 7.2 Linux x64
redistribution: Built from the exact unmodified strace 7.2 source on Ubuntu 22.04 GCC 11.4.0, targeting Linux x64 glibc 2.35+. Two independent builds produced identical stripped strace bytes. Optional mpers, stack unwinding, SELinux and termcap dependencies are disabled; only system libc and the loader are required. Full strace source, LGPL text, UAPI/test notices, exact first-party launcher/build sources and MIT license are retained. Native owned-file observation, kill-on-exit, timeout, launcher kill and owner-loss cleanup passed in the linked CI run. Public CLI and independent model acceptance are recorded separately.
